crossRefs.note: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,
He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals, defiling himself by it. I am Yahweh.
Yet you may kill and eat meat within all your gates, after all the desire of your soul, according to Yahweh your God’s…
You shall not eat any abominable thing.
in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.
forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those…
God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree…
To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there…
He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the…
wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.
Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has…
I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers…
for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a…
“All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things…
Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,
for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”
Whether therefore you eat, or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
Let no one therefore judge you in eating, or in drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,
“Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”
(all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?
forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those…
For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, if it is received with thanksgiving.

translations.web: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.
translations.bsb: Everything that lives and moves will be food for you; just as I gave you the green plants, I now give you all things.
translations.kjv: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given
translations.asv: Every moving thing that liveth shall be food for you; As the green herb have I given you all.
